scope_policy.note: scope is the group's COMPLETE bit set; claims are group-scoped only. ownership_unknown bits lie outside every group scope and therefore cannot falsify these claims, but no tile-wide claim is made here and none may be added while such bits exist.

split_policy.rule: a site whose evidence established the harness rules may inform predictions but never score them
